# Lab 5.15: Enforce 2-Step Verification

## What We Are Going to Do
Allow users to set up 2-Step Verification, give them time to enrol, then enforce it with security keys required for admins.

## Steps

1. **Allow enrolment.** In the Admin console go to **Security → Authentication → 2-step verification**. Select the top-level OU and tick **Allow users to turn on 2-Step Verification**. Save.

2. **Enrol a test user.** Sign in as Alice at `https://myaccount.google.com/signinoptions/twosv` and turn on 2-Step Verification with an authenticator app or a passkey.

3. **Enforce for Engineering.** Back in the Admin console, select the **Engineering** OU. Under **Enforcement**, choose **On from** a date a few days ahead. Set **New user enrollment period** to **1 week**. Save.

4. **Require security keys for admins.** Create a group `admins-2sv@yourdomain` with your admin users. Select that group in the 2-Step Verification page and set **Methods** to **Only security key**.

5. **Check enrolment.** Go to **Reporting → User reports → Security**. The **2-step verification enrollment** column shows who is enrolled.

6. **Plan for lockouts.** Open a user and click **Security → Get backup verification codes**, so you can help users who lose their device.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Enforcement | Engineering must use 2SV after the set date |
| Admins | Security keys only, the strongest option |
| New users | Get a one-week enrolment window |
| Recovery | Backup codes generated by admins |
